title: Cambridge IELTS 19 Test 4 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: The charts below give information on the location and types of dance classes young people in a town in Australia are currently attending.
scenario: The charts show the location of dance classes and the types of dance classes attended by two age groups.
requirements: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

visualData.type: Pie chart and horizontal bar chart
visualData.title: Location of dance classes; Types of dance classes (by age group)
visualData.units: Percent for location of dance classes; number of students for types of dance classes
notes: The pie chart categories are Private studios, School halls (after-school), College-based studios, and Community halls & other.
The bar chart compares Under 11 and 11–16 age groups for Ballet, Tap and Modern.
Clearly visible bar values are approximately: Ballet — Under 11: 600, 11–16: 300; Tap — Under 11: 450, 11–16: just over 400; Modern — Under 11: 300, 11–16: just over 500.
